summary: A Toronto orthodontic practice with 27 years of experience and virtual consultations is a strength, but dead menu parents and two different phone numbers appear to cost you new patients.

findings.problem: The New Patients and Treatment menu parents appear to link to #, and the search control and back to top links appear to link to # as well.
findings.cost: Patients looking for new patient information or treatments land nowhere.
findings.fix: Working pages behind every menu item.

findings.problem: The phone number appears as 416-391-4222 in most places and 1.866.486.4876 in the bottom call to action, and hours appear only in the footer.
findings.cost: Patients may call the wrong line and cannot see hours before they call.
findings.fix: One verified number and visible hours.

findings.problem: The slider appears to use a dummy.png placeholder, the before and after section appears to show only a placeholder, and the text 'at out office' appears.
findings.cost: Placeholder images and typos make a premium practice look unfinished.
findings.fix: Real photos, real before and after cases and proofread copy.

findings.problem: No online booking appears, a COVID-19 update link appears to remain, and no testimonials or reviews appear.
findings.cost: Old links and no proof or booking path lose patients to a clinic that shows both.
findings.fix: On site booking, current links and visible reviews.

redesign: Real photos, cases, booking and reviews.
